audit_bug_sweep.name: 1 (Security/Identity) — [LIVE-EXPLOITABLE] Any Administrator can promote themselves to Owner
audit_bug_sweep.notes: Owner-role assignment = Owner-only; block self-role-change; scope target to caller's companies; last-Owner guard.
audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: test that an Administrator cannot set role=Owner or re-role a user outside their companies.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: PATCH /identity/users/:id is gated only by isAdminRole (Owner OR Administrator) and the role UPDATE has no company scoping on the target and no anti-escalation guard. An Administrator can set role=Owner on themselves or anyone, in any entity.
audit_bug_sweep.impact: Full privilege escalation to Owner (the tier that moves money) — exploitable TODAY, not just at USMCA. The single most urgent item in the sweep.

audit_bug_sweep.name: C1 (Dispatch/Compliance) — Unqualified drivers assignable via quick-assign / quicksave / planner
audit_bug_sweep.notes: Extract the book-load qualification gate into one shared function called by every assignment path.
audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: CI grep that every assignment path calls the shared qualification gate.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: Book Load has the full E_DRIVER_NOT_QUALIFIED gate (deactivated/archived/CDL/medical) but the sibling assignment paths check only unit-block/HOS/drug — same structural flaw as the hazmat gap (D3-1).
audit_bug_sweep.impact: A terminated or expired-CDL driver can be put on a load — FMCSA driver-qualification violation on a live carrier.

audit_bug_sweep.name: C2 (Compliance/MOR) — Chapter 11 MOR cash lines are always $0 and omit own-transfer exclusion
audit_bug_sweep.notes: [DESIGN DOC #2063 — analysis + proof landed; awaiting owner build approval] amount_cents, group on is_credit, add own-transfer exclusion, remove the zero-swallow (fail loud). FINANCIAL — Jorge's OK.
audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: test MOR totals vs seeded bank rows incl a transfer.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: form-425c reads bt.amount but the column is amount_cents → 42703 → a catch returns receipts:0/disbursements:0 every month; even fixed, direction should be is_credit and there is no own-transfer exclusion (transfers double as receipt+disbursement).
audit_bug_sweep.impact: A sworn federal Chapter 11 filing shows $0 cash activity (or inflated gross); UST fees are assessed on disbursements. Highest-consequence item.

audit_bug_sweep.name: C3 (Accounting/Governance) — Three financial void endpoints have NO role guard
audit_bug_sweep.notes: Route through requireVoidCancelExecutor OUTSIDE any flag. FINANCIAL — Jorge's OK. Ties to void/cancel-governance lock.
audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: CI assert every void/cancel route calls the executor guard.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: Invoice void (role check only runs inside if(VOID_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED), default OFF), payment void, and factoring-advance void have no executor check — canVoidCancel exists but these bypass it. void/cancel is NOT uniformly Owner/Admin-only.
audit_bug_sweep.impact: Any authenticated user (Dispatcher/Safety/Driver) can void A/R evidence, unapply a customer payment, or void a factoring record.

audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: CI assert the cron is registered.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: verifyEventChain exists but no cron/route/script/render.yaml calls it (only 3 crons exist); ops.audit_chain_verifications is permanently empty. The open remainder of Block-19's verification layer.
audit_bug_sweep.impact: The legal-evidence ledger has no live proof-of-integrity; a tamper could sit undetected indefinitely.

audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: status test for the invalid_grant path.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: getQboConnectionStatus returns connected:true for any non-revoked row; there is no needs_reauth state; on invalid_grant refresh just throws and the 15-min watchdog only alerts when connected===false (unreachable). Alerts are email-only to one address.

audit_bug_sweep.guard: Guard: CI fail on defined-but-never-called Sentry init + run-* without Sentry.
audit_bug_sweep.root_cause: run-recon/run-loves-card-import cron entrypoints never init Sentry and bypass wrapBackgroundJobTick; recon per-entity failures are console.error-and-continue; the alerts module is config-only (no engine); frontend/PWA Sentry init functions are never called; PWA ErrorBoundary is console-only.

audit_bug_sweep.impact: An invoice/bill/payment QBO push or settlement email claimed but never sent, never retried, never alerted.
